title: Less Practice
description: Practise the twelve ideas in this Less course. Choose an answer, then read why it fits the example.

exercises.question: What is the job of lessc?
exercises.explanation: Less is a CSS helper language. A compiler translates its extra features into the CSS that browsers already understand.

exercises.question: Which name is a Less variable?
exercises.explanation: Less variables start with @. A variable lets you reuse a value such as a colour or a spacing size.

exercises.question: What does .card p choose?
options: Only a paragraph outside a card
exercises.explanation: A nested selector chooses an element inside another element. Less combines the outer and inner selectors for you.

exercises.question: What element does &:focus-visible style here?
options: The button itself when it has visible focus
exercises.explanation: The & sign repeats the parent selector. It helps add a state to the same element rather than choosing one of its children.

exercises.question: Why use .soft-box() in both rules?
options: To share the same style recipe
exercises.explanation: A mixin is a group of style choices you can insert into another rule. Empty parentheses keep the recipe from making its own CSS class.

exercises.question: Which colour is used by .frame() without an input?
exercises.explanation: A mixin can accept a value, so one recipe makes several kinds of frame. A default is used when you leave the input empty.

exercises.question: What padding comes from 24px divided by 2?
exercises.explanation: Less can calculate a size from other sizes. Parentheses make the calculation clear, especially when dividing.

exercises.question: What does @import load in this example?
exercises.explanation: An import brings another Less file into the build. This helps keep shared choices separate from the styles that use them.

exercises.question: Why does the 24px call get bold text?
exercises.explanation: A guard is a rule that decides whether a mixin should run. It can choose a style based on an input number.

exercises.question: What does lighten do?
exercises.explanation: Less has colour functions. A function takes a colour and calculates another colour from it.

exercises.question: What class name does the example create?
exercises.explanation: Interpolation puts a variable value inside a selector name. It can make a named theme class.

exercises.question: Who checks the media query screen size?
options: The browser when it displays the page
exercises.explanation: A media query chooses styles for certain screen sizes. Less can place it inside the component rule and build normal CSS.
